name: Typography
description: Multi-language typography server: language profiles (clreq/jlreq/klreq parameters, prohibition class sets, right-to-left languages), Unicode line breaking and bidirectional text (UAX #9 through Unicode.Bidi, with P2/P3, L1, L2 and mirroring done here), a boundary model that carries break and spacing decisions, HarfBuzz shaping with language-aware glyph-level output, display-form substitution (quotation marks, ellipsis, sentence marks), automatic hyphenation from TeX patterns, ruby and emphasis marks, image-text mixed layout with polygon wrapping, and an async server architecture
author: shitake2333
